supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, state mutation, provenance, cache/failure boundary or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Deadline from match confirmation if nonnull else range_end. Compute S20 then S22 unconditionally before arbitration; Type3 nonnull and Type4 absent or final event<=other wins. Else Type4, else S12 if Order, else null. No Order-backed geometry if independent route wins.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, state mutation, provenance, cache/failure boundary or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Fresh output, clear windows then audit map in place. Audit all A before cycle. Set cycle start range_start; enumerate every sorted A, ordinal one-based before exclusions. Ownership first, then source<cycle or source==cycle and nonempty output. No independent acceptance assertion.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, state mutation, provenance, cache/failure boundary or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Next sorted A confirmation evaluated even if next A later excluded; normalize current price then S07 confirmation then S10 stop. Null skip. Resolve first Order after stop BEFORE comparing next A confirmation. Stop>=next rejects equality. Returned confirmation time may include RE61 fallback.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, state mutation, provenance, cache/failure boundary or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Open window appended before resolver, null leaves open. Successful append then cycle start=source main, close last window max(stop,decision+1us), exclusive end includes decision when representable. Overflow or failure may leave partial state. Stable final output sort; ownership list stays insertion order.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, state mutation, provenance, cache/failure boundary or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Dedup ledger by integer physical First/Break; missing reaction skips. Existing null crossing replaced by any nonnull crossing, even malformed; first nonnull stays even if later richer valid entry. Shape validation happens only after dedup, not in preference. Dict replacement does not change original identity insertion order.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, state mutation, provenance, cache/failure boundary or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Read retained reaction First before confirmation type test. isinstance datetime (not exact naive test), normalize required stop_level. Crossing shape tuple len>=3 and datetime element 2; no local first-two-field validation or strict price proof for accepted shape. Otherwise recompute via mixin. Null or not strict confirmation<event skips; stable sort by event,confirmation,First,Break.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, state mutation, provenance, cache/failure boundary or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Per S lower bound crossing time at source main inclusive, only first candidate examined. Strict earlier than old decision required. No confirmation>=S source check or parent match. No winner retains same record object.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, state mutation, provenance, cache/failure boundary or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Winner reads current entry/reaction, converts First/Break/top/bottom source indexes before replace. Replaces color red and full Order provenance, clears Reset number/time, uses crossing index int and supplied main/event fields. Unlisted formation_type, A and frozen geometry unchanged. Does not mutate Order entry or ownership windows; returns fresh list in original S order.

findings.description: Preserve native confirmation fallback at next-A expiry.
findings.resolution: Compute next A S07 returned confirmation if next exists (even if later ineligible; RE61 may return Break-open fallback rather than observed crossing).
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.

findings.description: Distinguish presence-only dedup from later crossing validation.
findings.resolution: first wins unless retained stop_cross null and new non-null, then replace; dedup preference tests presence, not shape, so a malformed non-null crossing can prevent later valid-entry preference.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.

findings.description: State exact trust boundary for accepted ledger crossing.
findings.resolution: If supplied stop_cross not tuple len>=3 with datetime element 2, compute mixin shared stop cross. A supplied crossing passing that shape test is accepted without independent price-crossing proof or local validation of its first two elements.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.

findings.description: Align state machine with presence-only preference and later shape gate.
findings.resolution: Dedup physical First/Break, prefer non-null crossing before shape validation; use supplied tuple len>=3 with datetime element 2 or recompute; require confirmation<stop; sort stop,confirmation,First,Break
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.
